{"metadata":{"description":"DSH Web 选中批注插件：选文字→批注→回车随消息发送；气泡隐藏批注块（零闪烁）；回复按 Annotation N 逐条对照（可悬浮芯片）。官方 bundle，零核心改动","id":"gh:1330089831","install_available":true,"language":"HTML","name":"dsh-annotation","slug":"omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH Web 选中批注插件：选文字→批注→回车随消息发送；气泡隐藏批注块（零闪烁）；回复按 Annotation N 逐条对照（可悬浮芯片）。官方 bundle，零核心改动"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-annotation"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Selection-annotation plugin for DSH Web: select text → annotate → press Enter to send it along with "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"your message; the model replies to each annotation by number."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"🌐 Live Product Site — Explore dsh-annotation in DSH"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Select any text in an assistant reply to annotate it (the annotation body may be left empty = just m"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ark the passage). Annotations accumulate across messages and turns. An **Annotations ×N** chip appea"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"rs next to the input box — hover to view all annotations, remove them one by one. Press Enter and th"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"e annotation block goes to the model together with whatever question is in the input box. **The anno"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"tation block never shows up as text in your own message bubble** — only the question plus the chip ("},{"id":"p6s6","text":"content visible on hover; hidden before paint, zero flicker). The model replies with `Annotation 1: "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"…` … `Annotation N: …`, one per annotation, and every Annotation label in the reply is a hoverable c"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"hip showing the annotated passage and your note."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Form: official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + a `dsh.client` declaration in package.json, injecte"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"d into the browser via client-modules; the Node half is an empty implementation). **Zero core change"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"s** — no DSH files are touched; `cordis.patch.yml` only inserts its own id once, and the profile pat"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"iles are touched; `cordis.patch.yml` only inserts its own id once, and the profile patch stays `[]`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Sidebar file annotations (DSH 0.1.6-alpha.1): select plain text, Markdown, or code in a workspace fi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"le preview and use the same annotate, save, and Enter-to-send flow. The editor and model-facing quot"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e include the file path. After reloading and reopening the original file, its markers are restored; "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"identical passages in different files remain separate. PDF, images, and HTML inside iframes are not "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"l passages in different files remain separate. PDF, images, and HTML inside iframes are not covered."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Feature | Description |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Select-to-annotate | Select assistant text → toolbar "Annotate" → write your note (may be empty); "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"dismiss by clicking elsewhere or pressing Esc |
| Numbered marker + highlight | A blue numbered mark"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"er + highlight anchored to the passage, viewport-anchored with collision avoidance, never lost when "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"scrolled out of view |
| Cross-turn collection | Any number of annotations accumulate across message"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"s/turns, numbered from 1 |
| "Annotations ×N" chip | Small chip beside the input box; hover shows ev"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ery annotation, deletable individually |
| Enter sends with your message | Annotation block + the qu"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"estion in the input box are sent to the model together (the model receives the full content) |
| Hid"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"den in your bubble | The annotation block is removed from your bubble's DOM the moment you send (bef"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ore the browser paints), leaving only the question + the chip (hover to view); historical messages s"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"elf-heal after a refresh |
| Numbered reply correspondence | A format instruction is injected into t"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"he message so the model replies `Annotation 1: …` … `Annotation N: …` one by one |
| Reply annotatio"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"n chips | `Annotation N:` in the reply renders as hoverable chips showing the passage + your note |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Interaction flow"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install (official bundle path · the only one)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"To add it only as a Node dependency in an existing project:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> `npm install` only adds the dependency; it does not register the plugin with DSH. Use `dsh plugin "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"add` above when installing it into DSH."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Migrating from the old `@omdsh-dev` package name"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"If you installed the plugin before v1.4.2, remove the old dependency before installing the renamed p"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"installed the plugin before v1.4.2, remove the old dependency before installing the renamed package:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"If `dsh web` still fails and mentions `@omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation`, remove only the stale `dsh-annota"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"tion` entry that uses that old name from `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`. The plugin now supp"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"lies the `@changfenhuang/dsh-annotation` entry itself."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Do | Don't |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Only `dsh plugin add` / only write `bundles` | **Never** insert the same id again in the profile/h"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ome `cordis.patch.yml` |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Self-check:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Architecture notes"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Pure browser-side**: everything lives in `client.js` (a hand-written CJS bundle, no build step, "},{"id":"p29s2","text":"served no-cache per request)
- **Message format** (the literal protocol block sent to the model; fol"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"lows the DSH `locale` preference — zh or en):"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The zh delimiter is 「提问：」(ask:) rather than 「问题：」(question:) — the heading line "回答我的问题：" also conta"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ins the latter, and the bubble-hiding surgery would misfire on it; the en delimiter is `Ask:`. Hidin"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"g and reverse-parsing accept both languages plus the legacy 「问题：」 marker.
- **Bubble hiding**: user "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"bubbles are plain-text rendered (a single MessageText node, not markdown); a MutationObserver in the"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" microtask phase (before paint) splits at the last `\n提问：`, cuts the annotation block, and attaches "},{"id":"p31s6","text":"the chip; a 1 s polling fallback plus historical-message repair after refresh
- **Reply chips**: aft"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"er streaming settles (`data-streaming` removed), each `Annotation N:` is replaced with a hoverable c"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"hip; item data is stored on the most recent user message carrying the annotation tag (`tag.__annotat"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"ionItems`) and rebuilt after refresh; **snapshot the text nodes collected by the TreeWalker before t"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"ouching the DOM, then replace one by one** — replacing a child mid-walk invalidates the walker point"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"er and only the first node gets processed
- **Locale-aware**: UI copy and the protocol block follow "},{"id":"p31s12","text":"DSH's `locale` service (`zh`/`en`, live switch); historical bubbles stay parseable across languages;"},{"id":"p31s13","text":" missing locale service falls back to zh
- **IME-safe**: the Enter interception carries `isComposing"},{"id":"p31s14","text":"` / keyCode 229 guards; never hard-edits the composer textarea's DOM; `setDraft` only assembles the "},{"id":"p31s15","text":"annotation block at the last moment before submit and never clobbers the user's draft
- **No relianc"},{"id":"p31s16","text":"e on send-completion event chains**: bubble decoration uses MutationObserver + polling (`watchInputD"},{"id":"p31s17","text":"raft` can be ineffective before the session is loaded at init; it is only a staging entry)
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
